question: Take the enzymes tissue enriched in heart muscle, keep those secreted to blood, then keep those with a validated unfavourable prognosis in breast invasive carcinoma (TCGA). Report the count at each step. For the genes that remain, give their blood concentrations by immunoassay and mass spectrometry and a scatter of the two on log axes, with the table.

tool_uses.name: sql
tool_uses.input: {"query":"SELECT \"Gene\", \"Protein class\", \"RNA tissue specificity\", \"RNA tissue distribution\", \"Secretome location\", \"Cancer prognostics - Breast Invasive Carcinoma (TCGA)\" FROM proteinatlas WHERE lower(\"Protein class\") LIKE '%enzyme%' AND lower(\"RNA tissue specificity\") LIKE '%tissue enriched%' AND lower(\"RNA tissue distribution\") LIKE '%heart muscle%' LIMIT 50"}

tool_uses.name: sql
tool_uses.input: {"query":"SELECT \"RNA tissue specificity\", \"RNA tissue distribution\", count(*) FROM proteinatlas WHERE lower(\"Protein class\") LIKE '%enzyme%' GROUP BY 1,2 ORDER BY count(*) DESC LIMIT 30"}

tool_uses.name: sql
tool_uses.input: {"query":"WITH x AS (SELECT p.\"Gene\", p.\"Protein class\", p.\"RNA tissue specificity\", p.\"Secretome location\", p.\"Cancer prognostics - Breast Invasive Carcinoma (TCGA)\" AS prog, r.\"nTPM\" FROM proteinatlas p JOIN rna_tissue_consensus r ON p.\"Gene\"=r.\"Gene\" WHERE lower(p.\"Protein class\") LIKE '%enzyme%' AND p.\"RNA tissue specificity\"='Tissue enriched' AND lower(r.\"Tissue\")='heart muscle') SELECT * FROM x WHERE lower(\"Secretome location\") LIKE '%blood%' OR lower(\"Secretome location\") LIKE '%secreted%' LIMIT 100"}

tool_uses.name: sql
tool_uses.input: {"query":"SELECT \"Secretome location\", count(*) FROM proteinatlas WHERE \"Secretome location\" IS NOT NULL GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY count(*) DESC LIMIT 20"}

tool_uses.name: sql
tool_uses.input: {"query":"SELECT Tissue, count(*) FROM rna_tissue_consensus WHERE lower(Tissue) LIKE '%heart%' GROUP BY 1"}

tool_uses.name: sql
tool_uses.input: {"query":"SELECT p.\"Gene\",p.\"RNA tissue specificity\",p.\"RNA tissue distribution\",p.\"RNA tissue specific nTPM\",p.\"Protein class\",p.\"Secretome location\" FROM proteinatlas p WHERE p.\"RNA tissue specificity\"='Tissue enriched' AND p.\"Secretome location\"='Secreted to blood' AND lower(p.\"Protein class\") LIKE '%enzyme%' LIMIT 20"}

tool_uses.name: sql
tool_uses.input: {"query":"WITH s AS (SELECT Gene FROM proteinatlas WHERE lower(\"Protein class\") LIKE '%enzyme%' AND \"RNA tissue specific nTPM\" LIKE 'heart muscle:%'), b AS (SELECT DISTINCT gene FROM blood_immunoassay_concentration), m AS (SELECT DISTINCT \"Gene\" AS gene FROM blood_ms_concentration) SELECT count(*) AS n_enriched, sum(CASE WHEN p.\"Secretome location\"='Secreted to blood' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS n_blood, sum(CASE WHEN p.\"Secretome location\"='Secreted to blood' AND p.\"Cancer prognostics - Breast Invasive Carcinoma (TCGA)\"='Validated unfavorable' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS n_final FROM proteinatlas p JOIN s ON s.Gene=p.Gene"}

tool_uses.name: sql
tool_uses.input: {"query":"SELECT Gene,\"RNA tissue specific nTPM\",\"Secretome location\",\"Cancer prognostics - Breast Invasive Carcinoma (TCGA)\" FROM proteinatlas WHERE lower(\"RNA tissue specific nTPM\") LIKE '%heart%' AND lower(\"Protein class\") LIKE '%enzyme%' LIMIT 100"}

tool_uses.name: sql
tool_uses.input: {"query":"WITH e AS (SELECT Gene FROM proteinatlas WHERE lower(\"Protein class\") LIKE '%enzyme%' AND lower(\"RNA tissue specific nTPM\") LIKE '%heart muscle:%'), b AS (SELECT Gene FROM proteinatlas WHERE \"Secretome location\"='Secreted to blood'), p AS (SELECT DISTINCT Gene FROM cancer_prognostic_data WHERE lower(Cancer) LIKE '%breast invasive carcinoma%' AND \"validated prognostic - unfavorable\" IS NOT NULL AND \"validated prognostic - unfavorable\"<>'') SELECT count(DISTINCT e.Gene) enriched, count(DISTINCT CASE WHEN b.Gene IS NOT NULL THEN e.Gene END) blood, count(DISTINCT CASE WHEN b.Gene IS NOT NULL AND p.Gene IS NOT NULL THEN e.Gene END) final FROM e LEFT JOIN b USING(Gene) LEFT JOIN p USING(Gene)"}

tool_uses.name: sql
tool_uses.input: {"query":"SELECT Gene, \"Gene name\", Cancer, \"validated prognostic - unfavorable\", \"potential prognostic - unfavorable\" FROM cancer_prognostic_data WHERE lower(Cancer) LIKE '%breast invasive%' AND Gene IN ('PTGDS','MASP1','LPL','PLA2G2A')"}

tool_uses.name: sql
tool_uses.input: {"query":"SELECT DISTINCT Cancer FROM cancer_prognostic_data WHERE lower(Cancer) LIKE '%breast%'"}

tool_uses.name: sql
tool_uses.input: {"query":"SELECT Gene,\"Gene name\",\"validated prognostic - unfavorable\" FROM cancer_prognostic_data WHERE Cancer='Breast Invasive Carcinoma (TCGA)' AND Gene IN ('PTGDS','MASP1','LPL','PLA2G2A')"}

tool_uses.name: sql
tool_uses.input: {"query":"SELECT * FROM cancer_prognostic_data WHERE Cancer='Breast Invasive Carcinoma (TCGA)' LIMIT 3"}

tool_uses.name: sql
tool_uses.input: {"query":"WITH e AS (SELECT \"Gene\",Ensembl FROM proteinatlas WHERE lower(\"Protein class\") LIKE '%enzyme%' AND lower(\"RNA tissue specific nTPM\") LIKE '%heart muscle:%'), b AS (SELECT \"Gene\", \"ENSG ID\", \"conc [pg/L]\" im FROM blood_immunoassay_concentration), m AS (SELECT \"Gene\", \"ENSG ID\", \"Conc [pg/L]\" ms FROM blood_ms_concentration), p AS (SELECT Gene FROM cancer_prognostic_data WHERE Cancer='Breast Invasive Carcinoma (TCGA)' AND \"validated prognostic - unfavorable\"<>'') SELECT e.\"Gene\",e.Ensembl, b.im,m.ms FROM e JOIN proteinatlas x ON x.\"Gene\"=e.\"Gene\" JOIN p ON p.Gene=e.Ensembl LEFT JOIN b ON b.\"Gene\"=e.\"Gene\" LEFT JOIN m ON m.\"Gene\"=e.\"Gene\" WHERE x.\"Secretome location\"='Secreted to blood'"}

tool_uses.name: sql
tool_uses.input: {"query":"SELECT Gene,\"Gene name\",\"validated prognostic - unfavorable\" FROM cancer_prognostic_data WHERE Cancer='Breast Invasive Carcinoma (TCGA)' AND \"Gene name\" IN ('PTGDS','MASP1','LPL','PLA2G2A')"}

turns.text:
Using the Human Protein Atlas:

| Filtering step | Count |
|---|---:|
| Enzymes tissue-enriched in heart muscle | **86** |
| Also annotated as secreted to blood | **4** |
| Also had validated unfavourable prognosis in breast invasive carcinoma (TCGA) | **0** |

The four blood-secreted enzymes were **PTGDS, MASP1, LPL, and PLA2G2A**. None had a value in the HPA field **“validated prognostic - unfavorable”** for **Breast Invasive Carcinoma (TCGA)**.

Therefore, **no genes remained** for reporting paired blood concentrations, and the requested immunoassay-versus-mass-spectrometry log-scale scatter is empty.
